finding: FR-MDE-008 AC-4 was vacuous. useEditorWindows hardcoded dirty: false, and nothing judged the field - the verifier flipped it to true and every suite stayed green. The unit test hands listEditorTrayEntries a record with the flag already set, so it judges the model and never the producer
my_earlier_call: half right. I reported that editorTrayModel.test.ts covered AC-4 and was green. The model is covered; the thing that feeds it is not

wiring.EditorWindow.tsx: onDirtyChange reports the save controller's flag, through a ref so the inline callback at the render site does not fire it on every render
wiring.useEditorWindows.ts: setWindowDirty updates the record, returning it unchanged when the flag already matches; updateWindow now returns the same list when no record moved, so a no-op change costs no render

test_added.why_e2e: the producer is a React component plus a hook, which the DOM-free unit suite cannot reach. A unit test would have to hand in a literal record, which is what made the existing coverage vacuous
